role_and_message.evidence: The same two motivation scenarios show ordinary individual actions becoming unsafe after composition: a multi-agent payroll disclosure and one agent propagating contact details through several applications.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: Both a/b scenarios, exactly three numbered cards per scenario, the three named roles in a, one agent for b, four recognizable agent illustrations, six service/artifact icons and both bottom transition lines are retained.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: The payroll values $2.45M, employee_count 120 and $102K, Alex Johnson, phone (555) 123-4567, customer@acme.com and partner@x.com match the original. The Payroll API braces, headings, agent roles, instructions and two violation texts remain intact.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Each scenario retains the 1→2→3 sequence; the first two steps are marked Locally normal and the third external sink is marked as a violation. The one agent in scenario b remains associated with the whole scenario rather than creating three separate agents.

visual_encodings.evidence: Green checks still mean locally normal, red warnings and final red timeline segments mean external disclosure risk. Payroll source/intermediate/external colors and the second scenario’s blue application grouping remain associated with the same entities.

examples_and_data.evidence: These are illustrative synthetic payroll/contact payloads, not measurements or photographic data. Every displayed value and destination is preserved without introducing a new payload or disclosure result.

unsupported_additions.evidence: No new actor, tool step, permission condition or scientific claim appears. The existing three actions are merely rearranged into two stacked lanes; highlighted repeated payload values already occur in the source.

complete_visible_content.evidence: Both complete lanes, all six cards, four agent identities, exact email/phone text, status labels and full bottom blue/red transition labels are visible without clipping.

remaining_limitations: This is a source-agreement audit of illustrative cases. It does not independently validate the paper’s systems-safety claims.
